fields.sections.0.h: New Model K3.1 Pro Unveiled: Million-Token Context Window and Multi-Capability
fields.sections.1.h: Reinforcement Learning-Based Post-Training Achieves Simultaneous Improvement Across All Domains
fields.sections.2.h: Coding Agent Benchmark: Competing Shoulder-to-Shoulder with Leading Proprietary Models
fields.sections.3.h: Long-Horizon Complex Coding Tasks: Iterative Problem-Solving Ability Demonstrated
fields.sections.4.h: 3D Creation and Spatial Reasoning: Achieving CAD-Level Performance
fields.sections.5.h: Financial Analysis: Substantially Enhanced Document-Based Reasoning and Accuracy
fields.sections.6.h: Cyber Capabilities: Dual-Use Risk Control and Transparent Design Principles
fields.sections.7.h: Open Weights Principle: Defensive Security and Gradual Capability Diffusion
fields.sections.8.h: Immediate Deployment Across Entire Product Portfolio
fields.sections.0.ko: Kimi introduces K3.1 Pro, the first model in the K3 series, unveiling a next-generation 3T-class open-weights model equipped with a context window reaching one million tokens. The company states it has achieved substantive improvements across multiple domains including coding, 3D creation, financial analysis, and agent capabilities. Simultaneously, it has released a high-speed variant (K3.1 Pro Highspeed) delivering 2–3x faster response times compared to existing models. Both models are immediately available through Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and API, with plans to open all model weights by November 4.
fields.sections.1.ko: K3.1 Pro is an evolved version of K3 with significantly increased post-training computation. To enable large-scale reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, every layer of the stack has been optimized—from the reinforcement learning framework through long-context reasoning, training efficiency, sandbox infrastructure, rollout scheduling, and environment quality assurance platforms. These technical improvements ensure that each reinforcement learning phase yields stable and predictable results, with K3.1 Pro achieving consistent performance gains across all domains.
fields.sections.2.ko: Across coding, agent, and knowledge benchmarks, K3.1 Pro demonstrates performance equal to or close to the most capable proprietary models. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, K3.1 Pro achieved 65.7%, surpassing GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly trailing Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%). On the internal benchmark Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon, it achieved 61.2%, significantly exceeding K3's 55.95%, covering the full range of coding tasks from code fixes to complete project builds. Capabilities in combining game engines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot) with web development tools have been enhanced, delivering more sophisticated visual quality for games and web experiences.
fields.sections.3.ko: In internal testing, K3.1 Pro built a gait dynamics simulator based on a human anatomical model (human-atlas), and through 167 missions and 420 independent reviews, analyzed experimental results, diagnosed problems, and iteratively improved the gait controller. It improved from a state where the simulated human collapsed within seconds to alternating gait with 11.2 seconds of continuous walking. When reward shaping failed to improve arm movement, K3.1 Pro did not simply adjust reward values; instead, it conducted open-ended exploration of simulator dynamics, discovered and corrected 36 errors in shoulder muscle moment-arm calculations, and retrained the controller.
fields.sections.4.ko: On the BenchCAD benchmark, K3.1 Pro achieved 92.7% in tool use, approaching Claude Opus 5.5 (96.2%) and GPT-6 Astra (95.9%), inferring form, proportion, and spatial relationships from text descriptions, sketches, and reference images to generate practical 3D models. It excels particularly in parametric modeling—mechanical parts, architectural models, configurable products, and custom furniture design—and can write and execute scripts for Blender or CAD software to build and refine assets, adjusting geometry, materials, and scene composition. Through the 3D Make feature in Kimi.ai and apps, users can preview and edit models online, download for 3D printing, or export as video and Live Photo.
fields.sections.5.ko: With enhanced reasoning and agent capabilities, K3.1 Pro handles entire financial workflows end-to-end. It achieved 64.4 points on OfficeQA Pro v2, a top-tier result, and performs complex financial data analysis on real financial documents through document retrieval, cross-document verification, and multi-step numerical reasoning. It improved by 7.2 points over K3 in financial modeling and 11.6 points in financial research; in business operations simulation environments, it achieved approximately 4.2x performance improvement. To address claim-level accuracy—critical to financial analysis and investment research—improvements were made on real tasks and challenging prompts. The hallucination rate at the claim level dropped significantly from 23.4% on K3's internal benchmark to 8.3%.
fields.sections.6.ko: As K3.1 Pro's capabilities increased, the development team placed greater emphasis on analyzing the origins of cyber capabilities and their controllability. During development, as post-training expanded, vulnerability research performance steadily improved. Investigation revealed that cyber-related content was naturally embedded in general training data, and cyber tasks were mixed into the reinforcement learning environment. For open-weights distribution, cyber-related data was identified and removed in pre-training stages while maintaining general coding tasks. On the internal benchmark xdev-bench-hard, K3.1 Pro with risk mitigation measures recorded an 81.0% success rate (before measures: 90.5%). This result demonstrates that data removal meaningfully reduces cyber capability while showing that improved coding and long-horizon debugging abilities generalize to cyber tasks.
fields.sections.7.ko: The development team stated that while cyber capabilities are designed not to exceed the frontier, they plan to gradually increase capability in open weights over time. K3.1 Pro's aggressive cyber capability is intentionally constrained below levels the training pipeline could produce, and below the leading proprietary models released in the past three months or longer. The team explained that "capable models running on open, user-controlled infrastructure provide code auditing means to many teams," arguing that gradually diffusing capability distributes improvement to overall software security better than concentrating it in a small number of proprietary systems.
fields.sections.8.ko: K3.1 Pro is available across the entire Kimi product family effective immediately. It is accessible through Kimi.ai and mobile apps (iOS, Android, HarmonyOS), Kimi Work desktop app (Windows, Apple Silicon Mac), Kimi Code, and Kimi API. Enterprise administrators can enable use within their organizations (disabled by default). Kimi Business provides enterprise-grade data privacy and member management, with personal and organizational accounts completely separated.
fields.caveat: Benchmark scores are collected from Kimi's own evaluation or public leaderboards; independent verification under identical evaluation conditions is necessary. The cyber capability removal effect is based on internal benchmarks; the actual degree of risk mitigation should be verified through third-party monitoring.
